title: Project Engineer
description:
Requisition Number: 79131
  
  
**The company built on breakthroughs.
  
  
Join us.**
Corning is one of the world’s leading innovators in glass, ceramic, and materials science. From the depths of the ocean to the farthest reaches of space, our technologies push the boundaries of what’s possible.
  
  
How do we do this? With our people. They break through limitations and expectations – not once in a career, but every day. They help move our company, and the world, forward.
  
  
At Corning, there are endless possibilities for making an impact. You can help connect the unconnected, drive the future of automobiles, transform at-home entertainment, and ensure the delivery of lifesaving medicines. And so much more.
  
  
Come break through with us.
  
  
Our Optical Communications segment has recently evolved from being a manufacturer of optical fiber and cable, hardware and equipment to being a comprehensive provider of industry-leading optical solutions across the broader communications industry.This segment is classified into two main product groupings – carrier network and enterprise network. The carrier network product group consists primarily of products and solutions for optical-based communications infrastructure for services such as video, data and voice communications. The enterprise network product group consists primarily of optical-based communication networks sold to businesses, governments and individuals for their own use.
  
  
**Function/Dept Purpose Statement**
The Plant Engineering organization is the steward of our equipment and process. We maintain the equipment; conduct advanced troubleshooting; monitor equipment and process performance; and develop and implement process/equipment/procedure adjustments.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Supports drive to fundamental process understanding and lowest cost producer objectives.
* Supports the development and execution of plans to evaluate improvements in existing technology resulting in a superior product in terms of quality and/or cost.
* Supports and/or leads sub-teams on new equipment installation, process certification, documentation and training.
* Works with other team members to solve difficult technical, engineering related problems.
* Supports or leads small project teams to focus on continuous improvement activities, new product or process introductions, and cost reduction projects.
* Executes cost reduction and improvement (DMAIC) projects in line with business objectives.
* Trains operators and trades personnel on new equipment and processes.
* Trouble shoots material, process and equipment issues, identifies root cause and implements corrective action.

**Required Experience**

* 4-7 years’ experience in process engineering in manufacturing environment
* Exposure to industrial safety practices
* Demonstrated ability to deliver results while managing multiple tasks and issues effectively

**Required Knowledge**

* B.E. in Mechanical/Chemical/Mechatronics
* Expereince in Project Management/Project Execution
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Strong Data Analysis skills (Control Charts, Pareto Analysis, Pivot Table) and Analytical mindset
* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively as part of a team and/or as a team leader
* Technical aptitude conducive to building proficiency in troubleshooting manufacturing equipment and evaluating manufacturing data.
* Experience with MS-office (Excel, Word, Powerpoint) and MS Access.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or DMAIC project experience.
* PMP Certification preferred

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Lord's Mark Industries Limited is a diversified and fast-growing group with core businesses in Paper, LED-Solar, Diagnostics, and Medtech, built on a 26-year legacy in the Indian market. The organization focuses on creating sustainable businesses that deliver value to stakeholders and aims to become a globally recognized brand across multiple industries. As part of its expansion strategy, the group has entered emerging sectors such as EV, Insurance, Defence, Biotech, and Micro Biotech, while also exploring global market opportunities. With a strong emphasis on innovation, quality, and excellence, Lord's Mark Industries is committed to customer satisfaction and social responsibility. The group strives to make a positive impact in all its operating sectors and contribute to broader societal development.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Electronics Engineer role based in Vasai. The Electronics Engineer will design and develop electronic circuits and systems for products across the company’s business units, from concept through to production. Daily responsibilities include creating and reviewing circuit schematics, selecting components, collaborating with cross-functional teams to integrate designs, and participating in prototyping and testing activities. The role involves troubleshooting and optimizing electronic designs, preparing technical documentation, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards and safety requirements. The engineer will work closely with manufacturing and quality teams to support product validation, resolve issues, and improve reliability and performance.

Quali - BE. Electronics / Electrical. Fresher or 1 - 2 yrs exp with Electronics Industries mainly Production, Testing etc

Location Kaman

Salary as per industry norms. Accommodation will be provided for outstation candidates near the factory location.

Please share cv hr2@lordsmark.com OR call 9920019303.

title: Content Writer
description:
**Company Description**
 Prometteur is a leading global systems integrator and business transformation consulting organisation. Prometteur helps companies innovate and transform by leveraging its unique insights, differentiated services, and flexible partnering models. The company is among the Top mobile application development companies in India, and also a pioneer in web application development and Automation Testing. Prometteur has gained the trust of more than 300 offshore clients from 30\+ countries worldwide and has become a trustworthy software partner.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Job Description:
   

  

 We are looking for a creative and enthusiastic Content Writer to join our team. The ideal candidate should have strong writing skills, a willingness to learn, and an interest in creating engaging content across digital platforms. Candidates with a technical, literature, or media background and exposure to iGaming or online gaming content will be an added advantage.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities:
   

  

* Create high\-quality, engaging, and original content for blogs, websites, articles, and marketing materials
* Research industry\-related topics, especially in technology and online gaming/iGaming
* Edit and proofread content to ensure accuracy, clarity, and consistency
* Follow brand tone, style guidelines, and SEO best practices
* Collaborate with marketing, SEO, and design teams to develop content ideas
* Stay updated with content trends, digital marketing practices, and gaming industry updates


 Required Skills \& Qualifications:
   

  

* 1\-2 Year of experience in content writing
* Excellent written communication skills in English
* Ability to research topics and convert information into engaging content
* Basic understanding of SEO concepts is a plus
* Strong attention to detail and eagerness to learn Knowledge about writing blogs, webpages, business articles, whitepapers, etc., in brand style and format.
* Basic understanding of SEO and keywords usage.
* Understanding of content strategy, mapping, and branding.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks while collaborating smoothly with the design and marketing team.
* Experience in IT/SaaS/iGaming would be add\-on.


**Qualifications**
 Technical background (BE, BTech, or equivalent) OR
   

  

* Literature / Media background (MA in English, Mass Communication, Journalism, or related fields)
